Description
1 oz PAMP Suisse Gold Ka Bah Mecca Bar is a part of the Faith Series manufactured by the world’s leading precious metal refiner PAMP Suisse in the honors of the Islam religion which nearly has 1.2 billion followers around the world. The Gold Ka’ Bah, Mecca Bar is one of five bars to be released by the renowned brand PAMP Suisse in Gold Series, with each uniquely designed in celebration of different religious figures, monuments, and icons.
These PAMP Suisse – 1 oz Ka Bah Mecca Gold Bars are an excellent option for investors looking to diversify their precious metal portfolio or for those looking for a valuable gift for a special occasion. These 1 oz Gold Bars from renowned brand PAMP Suisse are made up of 1 troy oz of .9999 fine gold which exemplifies the beauty through the depiction of classic religious symbol. Each of these
Gold Bars
comes along with its original assay card which guarantees the metal weight and purity of the gold bar.
Design of PAMP Suisse – 1 oz Gold Ka Bah Mecca Bar
The obverse side of 1 oz PAMP Suisse Gold Ka Bah Mecca Bar features the depiction of the Ka Bah. Ka Bah is a cuboid building at the center of the Muslim’s most sacred mosque,
Al-Masjid al-Haram
, in Mecca, Saudia Arabia. The minaret towers of the Masjid al-Haram are visible along with the rays of the sunshine is depicted on the background of the Ka Bah. Making a pilgrimage to visit Mecca’s Mosque once in a lifetime is one of Islam’s five pillars.
Ka Bah is built of stone, marble, and limestone blocks and is covered in a cloth veil most of the time. Pilgrims can walk around the Ka Bah in a counterclockwise direction every day of the year except the one day in which the cloth surround the cuboid building is changed.
The reverse side of PAMP Suisse 1 oz Gold Ka Bah Mecca  Bar features the identifying features of the gold bar. The Pamp Suisse emblem is depicted on the top of the bar which includes the four letters PAMP in a small circle with Suisse inscribed below. Below the PAMP Suisse emblem, the weight and the purity of the gold bar are inscribed. At the bottom of the 1 oz Ka Bah Mecca Gold Bar, the assayer’s stamp and the unique serial number for each bar are inscribed. The Serial numbers inscribed on the gold bars consist of one-letter, six-number code.
Main Highlights of PAMP Suisse – 1 oz Ka Bah Mecca Gold Bar
Contains 1 troy oz of .9999 fine gold.
Manufactured by the PAMP Suisse.
The obverse features the depiction of Ka Bah i.e the cuboid building at the center of the Muslim’s most sacred mosque, Al-Masjid al-Haram, in Mecca, Saudia Arabia
The reverse features the depiction of the PAMP emblem along with the weight, purity, and assayers stamp.
Each bar is assigned a unique serial number
